dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where else do you think we should visit?

dialogues.speaker: "Teteltetl"
dialogues.text: If you head deeper, you'll find Wavey Bay, where warm waves caress golden sands, while to the east, you'll see Guiztli Ridge and Villa Guiztli — both of which are inhabited by some very special individuals.

dialogues.speaker: "Teteltetl"
dialogues.text: To the south of Guiztli Ridge, children have painted the splendor of the world into Colorfall Cliffs.

dialogues.speaker: "Teteltetl"
dialogues.text: Finally, to the far north, legend holds that a boundless trove of hilichurl treasures is buried in Paititi.

dialogues.speaker: "Teteltetl"
dialogues.text: This whole place is full of mysteries, just waiting for you to uncover!
